name: esbuild
reason: Build tool (vite/tsx). Its postinstall only verifies the platform binary that ships in an optional @esbuild/* package; reviewed 2026-11-20.

name: fsevents
reason: macOS-only optional file watcher dependency (chokidar/vite). Its install script only tries to build a native addon and falls back to a prebuilt binary; reviewed 2026-11-20.

name: electron
reason: The desktop shell. Its postinstall downloads the Electron binary from GitHub releases for the pinned version and checks it against the published checksums; expected for packages/desktop; reviewed 2026-11-20.
